create_filechanneladapter: create a FileChannelAdapter instance with notifications, responses, and events JSONL file paths
send_response: send an agent response string that appends to agent_responses.jsonl and events.jsonl
read_notifications: read new notifications from notifications.jsonl since the last read offset
wait_for_notification: block and poll for new notifications with a configurable interval and timeout
review_filechanneladapter: review the FileChannelAdapter class for file-based daemon to agent communication patterns
